tasks.label: Test X11 forwarding
tasks.command: if [ -n "$DISPLAY" ]; then xdpyinfo >/dev/null && echo "X11 forwarding works on $DISPLAY"; else echo "DISPLAY is empty. Reconnect VS Code after starting VcXsrv and enabling X11 forwarding."; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Run Olivia QMX+ GUI
tasks.command: if [ -z "$DISPLAY" ]; then echo "DISPLAY is empty. Run this from the SSH terminal that has X11 forwarding, or reconnect VS Code through that SSH session."; exit 1; fi; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb "${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python" "${workspaceFolder}/olivia_qmx.py"

tasks.label: Run Olivia simulator Station A
tasks.command: if [ -z "$DISPLAY" ]; then echo "DISPLAY is empty. Run this from the SSH terminal that has X11 forwarding."; exit 1; fi; OLIVIA_QMX_SIMULATOR=1 OLIVIA_QMX_STATION=A QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb "${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python" "${workspaceFolder}/olivia_qmx.py"

tasks.label: Run Olivia simulator Station B
tasks.command: if [ -z "$DISPLAY" ]; then echo "DISPLAY is empty. Run this from the SSH terminal that has X11 forwarding."; exit 1; fi; OLIVIA_QMX_SIMULATOR=1 OLIVIA_QMX_STATION=B QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb "${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python" "${workspaceFolder}/olivia_qmx.py"
